build_alexnet_backbone: build an AlexNet backbone feature extractor for 224x224 RGB images without a classifier
build_alexnet_classifier: build an AlexNet backbone with a classifier for a specified number of classes
run_alexnet_forward: run the AlexNet forward pass on input tensor x through features and optional classifier
review_alexnet_features: review the AlexNet features Sequential block with Conv2d, ReLU, and MaxPool2d layers
refactor_alexnet_init: refactor the AlexNet init to customize the feature extraction or classifier layers
